column2: PINNED MANIFEST of literature backing each category's inclusion ruling.
ontology/homeiot-sources.ttl may only cite a key that appears here;
scripts/ontology_build.py --check (and --sources) fails otherwise. This is the
same mechanism external_classes.tsv provides for alignment IRIs, and it exists
for the same reason: the failure mode in this file is a plausible-sounding
citation that does not exist. Four fabricated external classes were caught that
way; a fabricated reference would be worse, because it reaches the paper.
verified=yes   bibliographic details confirmed and safe to cite.
verified=no    TITLE comes from the project's own category dossier (a real
document the team compiled), but authors/venue/year here are
NOT confirmed and MUST be checked against the actual paper
before any of this reaches the report. Treat as a pointer to a
known study, not as a citation.
